name: @fromcode119/react-class-components
description: Class-based OOP primitives for React apps - a typed Reactor base component, @bound / @watch / @state decorators, and a method-bearing Enum base. React-only, zero framework dependencies, reusable in any project.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --external:react --external:react-dom --external:htm --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/lang.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=dist/lang.cjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:react --external:react-dom --external:htm --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/lang.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/lang.js
